caption: The theme editor on the home page of the theme test-data with the app embed of AskNest AI open as a chat window: the welcome text Hi! Ask me about store FAQs, products, shipping, returns, or product recommendations., two chips Show me best sellers and What is your return policy? the question What is your return policy? and an answer that says the bot does not have the return details available here and asks to contact the shop by e-mail for confirmation and help with the return request; the e-mail address in the answer is hidden (the tester had already covered it with a black block and it is covered again), and the store name in the header of the preview is hidden; the line below the field says that answers use the saved FAQs and the synced product data.

The same chat window after the chip Show me best sellers was used on the Free plan: four product cards with a link View product, The Multi-managed Snowboard, Selling Plans Ski Wax, The Collection Snowboard: Hydrogen and The Videographer Snowboard; the store name in the header of the preview is hidden.

The page Policies of the app: the heading Sync Shopify policies into AskNest AI, the button Sync policies, the message 1 policy page synced successfully., the card Policies synced 1 (Shopify policy pages stored for AskNest AI context) and the card Answer priority Hybrid (FAQs first, product-specific data second, policy pages third, then safe AI fallback); the store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The theme editor with the list of app embeds (AskNest AI Widget switched on, other apps off or on) and the same chat after the policy sync: the same question about the return policy and an answer that again says the bot does not have details available and asks to contact the shop by e-mail to confirm the terms; the e-mail address in the answer is hidden (the tester had already covered it with a black block and it is covered again), and the store name in the header of the preview is hidden.
